name: The Walk-In Negative
prompt: Plant two enormous translucent plum negatives in the ground, offset like sliding doors. Families stand in the gap so their live silhouettes join ghost portraits in the plates. A photographer at a curtained booth aligns the exposures.

name: The Camera Orchard
prompt: Grow a cluster of dark wooden camera boxes on jointed tripod trunks. Each points at a neighbouring camera whose bellows are open like a flower. A portrait sitter occupies one small clearing reflected throughout the grove.

name: The Silver Bath
prompt: Build a long shallow basin lined in mirror-polished silver. Attendants lift a flexible photographic sheet from the liquid with scarlet poles. A giant sepia image materialises halfway along the sheet as it curls onto the drying lawn.

name: Time in a Revolving Door
prompt: Arrange a circular set of open wooden doorframes behind a cobalt revolving shutter. A dancer runs through the frames with a yellow scarf. Successive exposures appear on frosted screens as a spiral of gestures around the empty centre.

name: The Portrait Picnic
prompt: Lay a patchwork of cyanotype cloth on the ground. Neighbours pose among ferns and everyday tools while assistants gently peel up already exposed corners, revealing brilliant white silhouettes against ultramarine. A low sink overflows with rinsed blue squares.
